comments.text:
In the middle of the Sahara, where a whole year of rain is less than a tenth of an inch, hundreds of camels still come down every day to drink from one black canyon pool, the one a handful of crocodiles call home. 🐪🐊
If you lived in Chad for a week, what would you plan your day around first: the water cart, the rains, or the nearest well?
